title: Lifting affine-line pullback endomorphisms to the base
statement: Let S, Lambda and M satisfy the hypotheses of [lem-pur-a1-pullback-endomorphism-rigidity], omitting its endomorphism normalization. Every endomorphism h of p-star M is p-star b for some endomorphism b of M. Here p is the affine-line projection [def-sbc-affine-space] and inverse images are the canonical intrinsic fixed-coefficient inverse images [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image].

proof.text: Use [new-lem-pur-intrinsic-lisse-fixed] to transport M to fixed coefficients. By [lem-sf-proetale-locally-constant-origin], obtain an etale sheaf G and an isomorphism from its comparison inverse image to the inverse realization of M. Realizing it and composing with the counit gives v from the intrinsic comparison image of G to M.

source.place: Tag 0A3H, lemma-sections-upstairs; fixed-module coefficient transport by sites.tex Tag 00YV and proetale.tex Tag 099Y

proof.text: Etale affine-line pullback is full by [new-lem-pur-etale-a1-pullback-full]. Comparison is full by its invertible ordinary unit [prop-weil-pbc-site-comparison-finite-level], and intrinsic realization is an equivalence. The comparison pullback isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback] and the realization unit identify the composite with comparison followed by intrinsic affine-line pullback. Hence this composite is full. Conjugate h by p-star v, lift it through the full composite, and conjugate its comparison image by v. Functoriality and the two inverse identities give exactly p-star b equals h.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtale_a1_pullback_lift (S : Scheme.{u})
    (Λ : Type u) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (M : proEtaleRingModules S (proEtaleConstantRing S Λ))
    (hM : IsLocallyConstantProEtaleModuleSheaf S Λ M)
    (hfinite : ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (y : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S),
      Finite ((finiteCoefficientModuleStalkFunctor y Λ).obj M))
    (h : (sfIntrinsicPullback Λ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S ↘ S)).obj M ⟶
      (sfIntrinsicPullback Λ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S ↘ S)).obj M) :
    ∃ b : M ⟶ M,
      (sfIntrinsicPullback Λ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S ↘ S)).map b = h
